title: Glowing key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x="38" y="42" width="42" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="38" y="42" width="42" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#FFE88A"/>
  <!-- Key teeth -->
  <rect x="66" y="50" width="7" height="10" rx="2" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="76" y="50" width="7" height="14" rx="2" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <!-- Key bow (ring) -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="18" fill="#FFB300"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#FFE88A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="10" fill="#1A1A3A"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="47" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Glow rays -->
  <g stroke="#FFF59D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.8">
    <line x1="12" y1="47" x2="4" y2="47"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="30" x2="12" y2="23"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="22" x2="30" y2="14"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="30" x2="48" y2="23"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="47" x2="56" y2="47"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="64" x2="12" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="64" x2="48" y2="71"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="72" x2="30" y2="80"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <circle cx="14" cy="38" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="28" r="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="66" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="20" cy="58" r="1.5"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small star sparkle -->
  <path d="M 72 30 l 2 5 l 5 2 l -5 2 l -2 5 l -2 -5 l -5 -2 l 5 -2 z" fill="#FFF59D"/>
</svg>
